# Miami Elio — Full AI & LLM Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

## 3. Miami Geographic Clusters & Logistics Reference

- **Bay / Core Cluster:** Brickell ↔ Downtown Miami / Kaseya Center (`8–12 min`) ↔ Bayside Marina (`8 min`) ↔ Key Biscayne (`15 min`).
- **Art / Luxury Cluster:** Wynwood ↔ Design District (`7 min`) ↔ Edgewater (`10 min`).
- **Beach / North Cluster:** South Beach ↔ Mid-Beach (`10 min`) ↔ Surfside / Bal Harbour (`20 min`) ↔ Sunny Isles Beach (`28 min`).
- **South / West Cluster:** Coconut Grove ↔ Coral Gables (`10–12 min`) ↔ Brickell (`15–20 min`).
- **Airports & Stadiums:** `MIA` ↔ Brickell (`18–30 min`), `MIA` ↔ South Beach (`25–40 min`), `FLL` ↔ Brickell (`35–55 min`), Brickell ↔ Hard Rock Stadium (`30–50 min`).

## 4. ELIO+ Guide Capabilities & Factual Boundaries

- **Zero-Hallucination Grounding:** ELIO (`ELIO+ Guide`) quotes only verified catalog prices, capacities, neighborhoods, live TicketNetwork event dates, and official 7-day NOAA/NWS Miami weather forecasts (`KMIA`).
- **Reservation Handoff Policy:** ELIO recommends, compares, calculates multi-day car budgets, and surfaces direct booking cards, but does not directly charge payment cards or confirm third-party reservations inside the chat text. Guests complete reservations on the linked official partner platform, via live manager chat handoff, or through a verified MIAMI ELIO checkout link (`/pay/<token>`) with mandatory ESIGN electronic agreement prior to Stripe 3DS2 / PayPal Business settlement.
- **ELIO+ Shield & Care 24/7:** Confirmed bookings paid through MIAMI ELIO include our contractual 100% Fulfillment & Replacement Guarantee (not an insurance policy; Fla. Stat. § 626.9541) and 24/7 dedicated live specialist support, with a private direct phone line unlocked exclusively after payment confirmation.
